framework_alignment: Controls mapped to OWASP ASVS 5.0 and OWASP API Security Top 10

authentication.evidence: Constant-time comparison via secrets.compare_digest in api/security_auth.py; 401 on missing/invalid tokens.
authentication.coverage: APIKeyHeader & HTTPBearer support with structured AUTH_SUCCESS / AUTH_FAILURE logging.

authorization.evidence: Server-side role hierarchy (PUBLIC, USER, RESEARCH, ADMIN) in api/security_auth.py; 403 on role breach.

session_token_security.coverage: Production deployment assumes tokens are rotated via environment secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets / Vault).

input_validation.evidence: Pydantic contract schemas on symbol, horizon, regimes; SQL identifier whitelist in engine/security_validators.py.

api_security.evidence: Global error sanitization masks stack traces and internal paths into opaque request_ids; docs disabled in production.
api_security.coverage: FastAPI exception handlers & docs_url conditional on BTC_ENVIRONMENT.

transport_security.evidence: SecurityHeadersMiddleware injects HSTS (max-age=31536000), CSP, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
transport_security.coverage: TrustedHostMiddleware blocks Host header poisoning; strict CORS allowlist.

secrets.evidence: Zero secrets in Git (.env ignored); regex secret masking in engine/security_audit.py before logging.
secrets.coverage: Secrets scan verified clean across codebase.

filesystem.evidence: Realpath jail in engine/security_validators.py blocks directory traversal (../); production model weights frozen.
filesystem.coverage: Direct static file exposure of .db, .py, or model files blocked.

database.evidence: Single canonical database experiments/results/market_memory.db in WAL mode; no arbitrary client query endpoints.
database.coverage: Public HTTP cannot download database or execute raw SQL.

websocket.evidence: Connection limit (5 per IP), message ceiling (64 KB), ping/pong restriction in api/server.py.
websocket.coverage: Arbitrary command execution through WebSocket strictly blocked.

logging.evidence: Structured JSON security audit logging in experiments/logs/security_audit.log with automatic secret masking.
logging.coverage: Logs security lifecycle events (AUTH, AUTHZ, SSRF, PATH_TRAVERSAL, MUTATION).

monitoring.evidence: Degraded forecast monitor (1% alert threshold) & research stop rule active.

dependency_security.evidence: Dependencies pinned in requirements.txt; verified zero known CVEs in current runtime.

deployment_security.evidence: Reverse proxy TLS 1.3, WSS, and read-only container mounts documented in docs/security_deployment_checklist.md.

rate_limiter_implementation.recommendation: In multi-worker/multi-container production deployments, rate limiting must be placed at reverse proxy/WAF boundary (Nginx/Cloudflare) or backed by shared Redis store.
